wstep: There is no recipe here for caramelized onion jam with wine.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to Ask Extension, onions are a low-acid vegetable, so they must be pressure canned to prevent botulism.
Almost any food that is not very acidic, with a pH above 4.6, can support the growth of Clostridium botulinum and toxin production.
According to the FDA, the minimum temperature for growth and toxin production by Clostridium botulinum type E and nonproteolytic types B and F is 38°F (3.3°C).

akapity: The FDA list gives white onions a pH of about 5.37–5.85.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe that uses wine to acidify onion jam.
This jam is meant to be kept in the refrigerator.
